L2t: The Tiki Totem is a decorative furniture item in Terraria, used as a placeable object.
L3t: Terraria's major 1.2 update, released in 2013, added a large batch of new decorative furniture and items that included the Tiki-themed objects.
L4t: The Tiki Totem was introduced in desktop patch 1.2.
L2f: The Tiki Totem is a decorative item in Terraria that is crafted from Tiki-themed materials gathered in jungle biomes.
L3f: The Tiki-themed items were added alongside the Tiki Armor, which arrived with the Pirate Invasion update in the later 1.3 series.
L4f: The Tiki Totem was introduced in desktop patch 1.3.
